engine.fail.lowIntegrity: MI CS was started from a Low-integrity folder. Windows gives a process the integrity level of the folder its image sits in, so the engine cannot write its state database or reach the privileged helper — both are healthy.
engine.fail.lowIntegrity.fix: Run the installed copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MI CS, or extract the release archive into a folder outside any web root or sandbox output folder.
engine.fail.dataDir: The engine's data folder is not writable.
engine.fail.dataDir.fix: Make sure %LOCALAPPDATA%\MICS is writable, or run the installed copy of MI CS.
engine.fail.missing: mics-engine.exe is not beside the app.
engine.fail.missing.fix: Extract the release archive in full, or reinstall MI CS.
engine.fail.spawn: The engine process could not be created.
engine.fail.spawn.fix: Try again; if it keeps failing, run the installed copy.
